# DataScript

The optional Datalog evaluator uses the unmodified `datascript` npm package, pinned at 1.8.1. Its distribution identifies Copyright 2014–2021 Nikita Prokopov and the Eclipse Public License. The upstream license is included as `datascript-LICENSE`, retrieved from the upstream 1.8.1 tag:

https://github.com/tonsky/datascript/tree/1.8.1

Source code is available at that URL. No DataScript source changes are made by this project. The npm dependency retains its upstream notice; this notice and license are included in the published package. This project's own TypeScript wrappers and policy remain under the project's license.
